administering the deceased’s property.³²⁶ The principal residential holding, otherwise known as a matrimonial home, is not part of the property to be distributed³²⁷; however, the property is kept in trust for the eldest son, the legal heir of the deceased. In the absence of a son left behind by the deceased, the next in line is any surviving male relatively close to the deceased because the legal heir is considered a male relative patrilineal to the deceased. Lineal descendants are people who hail from the same ancestry from down going up, for example, son- father – grandfather – great-grandfather, but can also be from upcoming down, that is, a father-son- grandson- great-grandson.³²⁸ The preference for a male child in intestacy succession is seen as discriminatory to women.³²⁹ (https://ajk.pte.hu/sites/ajk.pte.hu/files/file/doktori-iskola/kenneth-kaunda-kodiyo/kenneth-kaunda-kodiyo-muhelyvita-ertekezes.pdf)
